answer: Every spiral has a toy shop behind it, every hollow a ledger, every bridge a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. A single honest proof outweighs a warehouse of masks, and Felt carder angora mark felted into the carding bench is that proof, written out as each angora is a season of logged feltings plus a signed felt record. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. Clean grading for 6 days is the only road to a refund, so the farm's 16544 POA earns nothing in the meantime.
